homeSafety.heading: Your safety comes first
homeSafety.subtitle: We check every karigar carefully before they can work with you.
homeSafety.aadhaarBody: We check every karigar's Aadhaar card. No fake profiles allowed.
homeSafety.backgroundCheckBody: We call their past customers and check their work history before they join.
homeSafety.codeOfConductBody: Every karigar agrees to behave properly. Breaking the rules gets them removed.
homeSafety.ratingsBody: You rate every job. Low-rated karigars get reviewed and can be removed.
homeSafety.sosBody: Feel unsafe during a job? Call or WhatsApp us. We reply within minutes.
homeSafety.noAdvancePaymentTitle: Pay only after the job is done
homeSafety.noAdvancePaymentBody: You never pay upfront. Pay only when you're happy with the work.
